_comment: Used by lib/scorer.js to decide which of the 3 resumes to use for a job. Pass 1 is a title keyword match. Pass 2 cross-checks with skill-keyword overlap; if they disagree, the job is flagged for manual review instead of a silent guess. The resumeFile names must match the PDFs in resumes/.
notes: frontend_engineer is the default resume. The key product_engineer is kept from the original repo so existing sheet rows still work; it now means your full-stack CV. Edit the keyword lists any time as you see real results.
